title: WaterColor 765 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Lakefront on Western Lake; short walk to the beach.- 6-passenger low speed vehicle - 4 adult bikes- Located in Phase I (Park and Beach District)- Walking distance to the Beach Club, Cerulean Park, the Boathouse, and downtown Seaside- Private pool with built-in grill and fireplace *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $40 per day.- 2 parking spots- Complete Clean Linen Participant – ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club, featuring three pools (including a zero-entry pool), expanded lounge decks, the WaterColor Grill and the new sunset bar, Costa Chica, all overlooking the Gulf.DETAILS: Escape for idyllic days of rest and recreation at 765 Western Lake Drive. This remodeled 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home previously served as a single family’s oasis, and now hosts up to 12 guests for leisurely vacations! Boasting a private pool, inviting porches, a grill, and an outdoor fireplace, it’s the ultimate retreat. Guests will love the convenient location—less than a half-mile from the coveted WaterColor Beach Club and a 15-minute walk from Camp WaterColor—making it a breeze to enjoy the community’s sugar-soft beaches, zero-entry pool, lazy river, and other resort-style amenities!Bursting with charm, this 2-story property begins with a furnished front porch made for slow-paced mornings. Head inside to find blonde wood floors leading into a bright great room with elegant coffered ceilings and shiplap walls. Soft slip-covered sofas and armchairs encourage lounging and group movie nights in the living space, while a nearby dining table for 8 awaits intimate dinners or friendly game nights. The open kitchen is steps away—so the conversation never has to halt—and features stunning marble countertops, premium appliances, and a breakfast bar with 4 carved stools. Behind the kitchen is a butler’s pantry with a coffeemaker and a stacked washer and dryer. Wander through the French doors to savor alfresco breakfasts at the screened-in patio’s 8-person table, stretch out on the sunlit loungers in the backyard, or relax in the pool with a drink in hand while enjoying the melodic fountain feature and lush surrounding greenery. A built-in grill and an outdoor fireplace make it easy to maximize time outside. At the end of the night, a charming guest bedroom with a king bed provides a restful retreat on this level.Upstairs, discover a plush king bed and luxurious private bathroom in the spacious primary bedroom, complete with balcony access and a convenient washer and dryer in the closet. For additional sleeping accommodations, there’s a lovely guest bedroom with a king bed and a cheerful bunk room featuring 2 full-over-full bunk beds.With upscale amenities and a stellar location, 765 Western Lake Drive offers a fabulous WaterColor getaway. Plus, guests can easily explore all of 30A with parking for 2 vehicles, 4 complimentary bikes, and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle. Beach access is available at the WaterColor Beach Club and a second access is off Goldenrod Circle past the WaterColor Inn. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Full Bathroom with ShowerSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Large Walk-In Closet with Washer and Dryer, Private Bathroom with Separate Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Full-over-Full Bunk Beds (bunk room sleeps 8), Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and management fines.*Please note: Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
